title: Self-Serve Plan Auto-Migration Experiments and Billing Safety Net PRD
creator: Asha Patel
description: PRD to design and validate an automated, safe plan migration flow for self-serve customers whose consumption patterns indicate they should be moved to a higher plan or temporarily granted burst credits. Includes experiment design, UI/UX, API changes, telemetry, and billing acceptance criteria to ensure invoices, audit trails, and customer-facing notices are correct.
background: High-growth self-serve customers frequently hit quota boundaries or experience transient bursts. Support manually offers migrations or credits, but this is operationally expensive and inconsistent. We need an automated experiment to proactively migrate or provide safety-net credits while ensuring billing accuracy and customer transparency.
goals: 1) Reduce manual support escalations for quota overages by 40% for participating cohorts. 2) Validate automated migration heuristics with <1% false positives. 3) Guarantee zero-revenue leakage and correct invoice representation for migrated customers. 4) Provide clear customer notifications and rollback controls.
non_goals: Not targeting enterprise reserved contracts or Dedicated capacity in this experiment. Not changing core pricing or long-term billing models. Not implementing permanent plan changes without manual acceptance for customers in regulated jurisdictions.
requirements: - Implement a configurable experiment toggle scoped to cohorts (by org size, region, plan age). - Heuristic engine that recommends migration or temporary burst credits based on 7-day and 30-day usage trends and peak-to-median ratio. - Migration actions: (A) auto-upgrade to next plan with prorated charge, (B) assign temporary credit bucket that covers N tokens/hours. - Audit log record for every action with actor=system and reason. - Customer-facing email + console banner for any automated change, with clear step to opt-out/rollback. - Full reconciliation in billing system with clear line items distinguishing auto-migration charges and manual/credits. - Admin controls: immediate revoke, manual confirmation UI, and experiment-level kill switch.
rate_limit_spec: - When migrated/upgraded, new rate limits apply immediately for API token(s) attached to the org. - Legacy throttles honored until migration completes; migration must not cause dropped requests. - Temporary credit buckets respect per-route concurrency and per-caller concurrency caps; if exceeded, fallback to soft-throttle and informative error code (429 with X-Redwood-Reason=auto_migration_limit).
quota_spec: - Quota windows remain monthly or as configured by plan. - For temporary burst credits, token counters are snapshot and a separate ephemeral counter is created with TTL 7, 30, or 90 days depending on experiment arm. - On downgrade rollbacks, ephemeral credits are consumed before reverting base quota; usage attribution must preserve which tokens were charged to which line item.
entitlement_rules: - Auto-upgrade only to the immediately adjacent plan tier unless risk flags present. - Risk flags: outstanding invoice >30 days, security hold, region restriction. - Entitlement inheritance: existing per-route allowances remain; new plan adds additional allowances summarized in the audit record and invoice line item.
overage_handling: - If migration/temporary credit is insufficient during active window, system uses configured emergency burst policy: 1) apply safe-fallback model variant (lower cost) if available; 2) if not, throttle with clear error including guidance to upgrade. - Overage should never be silently billed; all charges must be surfaced on next invoice with a distinct memo 'Auto-migration charge' or 'Temporary burst credit usage'.
billing_acceptance_criteria: 1) Invoice test cases (unit/integration): a) auto-upgrade mid-cycle produces prorated line item with correct currency conversion and invoice total; b) temporary credits consumed show as zero-cost credit reduction and separate charge when applicable; c) rollback within 24h results in credit reversal on the invoice or next billing cycle. 2) No uncaptured revenue: end-to-end billing simulation to match expected revenue within ±0.5% across 1000 synthetic orgs. 3) Clear invoice memo and metadata: invoice line items include migration_id, experiment_id, original_plan, new_plan, proration_amount, and credit_bucket_id. 4) Accounting validation: sample of 10 real invoices verified by finance team for compliance with revenue recognition rules. 5) Customer-visible charge descriptions validated in email + console preview.
analytics_and_alerting: - Dashboard: cohort conversion (auto-upgrades accepted, opt-outs, rollback rate), support ticket reduction, false-positive rate, revenue delta. - Alerts: >2% unexpected downgrade/rollback rate in an experiment arm triggers immediate pause; >$10k/day unplanned revenue deviation triggers PagerDuty. - Logs: every migration action emits event to events stream including hashed org id, migration_id, reason, and pre/post quotas.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dry-run with staging billing and 50 synthetic orgs. Phase 1: opt-in beta for 50 real self-serve orgs (20% in North America, 20% in EU), monitor 2 weeks. Phase 2: expand to 500 orgs with A/B arms: auto-upgrade vs temporary credit vs control. Phase 3: evaluate results and either graduate feature to self-serve product or retire. Each phase requires finance sign-off and security review.
migration_flow_steps: 1) Heuristic flags candidate org. 2) Validate risk flags and billing standing. 3) Reserve proration & create migration draft in billing system (not yet invoiced). 4) Apply migration or grant temporary credits and write audit log. 5) Send customer notification and show console banner. 6) Monitor for 48h; if opt-out occurs, reverse per rollback rules. 7) At next billing cycle, reconcile drafts into invoices. 8) Emit final telemetry and mark experiment result.
api_changes: - New endpoint POST /internal/experiments/auto-migrate that accepts {org_id, experiment_id, action, reason} and returns migration_id. - Extend existing billing API to accept draft migrations with metadata fields migration_id, experiment_id, proration_blob. - Add read-only GET /orgs/{org_id}/migration-history for console display.
ui_changes: - Console: admin banner showing 'Auto-migration active' with migration_id and 'opt-out' button. - Billing preview shows drafts with tags 'Auto-migration (experimental)'. - Notifications center: templated email + in-product toast. - Experiment admin page to toggle cohort and view metrics.
notes: - Must coordinate with legal for EU customers regarding involuntary upgrades. - Finance needs ability to query migration_id line-items for audit. - Build observability with privacy-preserving hashed org ids.
